'''Arthur Donnell Long''' (born October 1, 1972) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player from [[Rochester, New York]]. A 6'9", 250 pound [[power forward (basketball)|power forward]] out of the East High School and [[University of Cincinnati]] who also attended [[Independence Community College|Independence Community Junior College]], [[Dodge City Community College]] in Kansas and [[Southeastern Community College (Iowa)|Southeastern Community College]] in Iowa, Long was not [[NBA draft|drafted]] but both the [[Portland Trail Blazers]] and [[Sacramento Kings]] signed him as a free agent in 1999, though he was waived before ever playing a game for either. He eventually played nine in games with the Kings from February 2001 until the season ended. He spent the majority of his college and pro career at power forward and center but as a high schooler, Long displayed the ability to put the ball on the floor and play small forward.

Long's NBA career lasted 98 games, and enjoyed his most successful year in the [[2001-02 NBA season|2001-02 season]], starting 27 of his 63 games with the [[Seattle SuperSonics]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/playerfile/art_long/ NBA.com: Art Long Bio<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> In 2002–03, he played 26 games (19 with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]], 7 for the [[Toronto Raptors]]). He also played 3 preseason games for the [[Cleveland Cavaliers]], but was waived prior to the [[2004-05 NBA season|2004-05 season]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/cavaliers/news/long_041026.html Cavaliers Waive Art Long], October 26, 2004</ref>

Long also played in [[France]] for [[ASVEL Lyon-Villeurbanne]] in 2000–01.<ref>[http://www.basket-stats.info/suproleague/teams/asvel.htm SuproLeague 2000-2001: ASVEL<!-- Bot generated title -->] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070202165508/http://www.basket-stats.info/suproleague/teams/asvel.htm |date=February 2, 2007 }}</ref>
